extraction.notes: The homepage announces that 2027 camps are coming in December; no 2027 Senior Music dates or registration opening were found. This extraction covers Senior Music only and is not a complete provider inventory: the official camps-by-type directory lists numerous additional academic, arts and sports programs that have not been fully extracted here. The existing-program list repeats Senior Music; the overnight card retains that name and the day version adds its type to distinguish the cards. The homepage's undated December 31 discount banner was not assigned to a registration year.

cards.review_notes: Dates are labeled 2026 using the homepage's 2026 camp heading and the program's September 2026 grade reference. Grades are interpreted as rising because the page says 'As of Sept. 2026'; it also explicitly admits 2026 graduates. The Welcome Center uses the official campus street address. Audition instructions conflict: the track section specifies advance string video auditions, whereas Camp Details also describes arrival auditions and mentions advance keyboard videos.

cards.review_notes: Dates are labeled 2026 using the homepage's 2026 camp heading and the program's September 2026 grade reference. Grades are interpreted as rising; 2026 graduates are also eligible. Sunday check-in is 2–4 p.m.; daily drop-off is 8–8:30 a.m. Hours vary by camp schedule, and Friday ends after the final concert at 3:30 p.m. Day campers must live in or stay with family in the immediate Greenville area. The listed transportation is a station/airport shuttle, not daily home-to-camp service. The Welcome Center uses the official campus street address.
